title: A collection's short sounds come as a drum rack, level-matched, in collection order
description:
As a crate digger, I want the short sounds of a collection on a drum rack, so that my kept hits and stabs are a playable kit in the DAW with one drag.

```gherkin
Feature: A collection's short sounds as a drum rack
  Background:
    Given a library with a collection "digs" holding, in order, the clips "riff" (1 bar), "loop-1" (2 bars), "shot-2" (1 beat) and "stab" (half a beat)

  Scenario: Items up to one bar long become pads, in collection order
    When I export the collection "digs" to "out" from the library
    Then "out/digs/digs.adg" has 3 pads
    And pad 1 is on note C1 and plays "riff"
    And pad 2 is on note C#1 and plays "shot-2"
    And pad 3 is on note D1 and plays "stab"

  Scenario: Pads are named after the clips
    When I export the collection "digs" to "out" from the library
    Then the pads of "out/digs/digs.adg" are named "riff", "shot-2" and "stab"

  Scenario: Pads are level-matched together as a drum kit's pads are
    When I export the collection "digs" to "out" from the library
    Then each pad's volume equals the gain Apricity gives that clip as a pad of a drum kit holding the same clips, within 0.1 dB

  Scenario: A collection with no item up to a bar long writes no rack
    Given a collection "long" holding only the 2-bar clip "loop-1"
    When I export the collection "long" to "out" from the library
    Then the export succeeds
    And "out/long" holds no ".adg"
    And it says "long: no clip is one bar or shorter; no drum rack written"
```

The one-bar limit is a proposal for the owner (M0 decisions, apricitus-e286ad).
